Given X, the fork Y←X→Z is blocked.P(y | do(x), z) = P(y | do(x))Observing a second consequence of the already fixed X adds no information about Y in this model.2. Can action become observation?× cutXYOriginal model: X→Y only. For this test cut X's outgoing arrow.
